Phase 4: Created DynamicModelRotationIntegrationTest.kt, simulating 429 block, 503 cooldown, full outage and self-healing. Implemented timeProvider in ModelQuotaManager to bypass JVM MockK System stack overflow issues.
Phase 2 & 3: Implemented dynamic rotation priority logic. Modified GeminiApiClient to support local baseUrl routing and Singleton ModelQuotaManager sharing.
Phase 1: Added okhttp-mockwebserver dependency to build catalog and module gradle dependencies.

errors_encountered.error: MockK static System.currentTimeMillis() mocking causes infinite loop and StackOverflowError in JVM
errors_encountered.solution: Introduced lambda timeProvider variable in ModelQuotaManager, allowing safe test injection of custom simulated clock.

errors_encountered.error: MockWebServer classes unresolved during test compilation
errors_encountered.solution: Added okhttp-mockwebserver dependency to build catalog and gradle script.

decisions_made.decision: Inject timeProvider rather than mocking static JVM classes
decisions_made.reason: Bypasses modern JVM security/mocking limitations and yields robust, testable design.
Allows clean redirection to MockWebServer local address without mutating global static variables.
